answer: Embodied challenge-response. Each identity must answer a fresh random physical task through a hardware sensor it cannot simulate: a camera must photograph a signed nonce on a willow branch in a specific pose, a microphone must capture ambient reef noise matching a local fingerprint, and a motion sensor must record a genuine wander path over uneven ground. The verifier checks sensor signatures and environmental consistency. An attacker must possess one real physical agent per identity, each bound to distinct sensor hardware and location, so mass cloning fails at hardware procurement cost.
